Type3 detection and honest fallback routing; session stopping point for P2 reached
Wired replace/delete/restyle/insert to the CLI in response to a user question about real-document testing
ToUnicode recovery plus a real pre-existing font-name-matching bug found and fixed for full-embedded-font editing
Kerning-pair support via legacy kern table, wired into the existing per-character drawing path

Block detection (engine/fonts/blocks.py) plus bounded reflow (engine/fonts/reflow.py, engine.edit.reflow_block, ReflowTextOp) -- never draws past a block's own line count. Closes out P2 at 20/20. One real bug found and fixed (identity vs value equality in find_block_containing).

Local FastAPI server exposing the Op layer over JSON, token-gated, local-only, undo/redo wired to the existing journal. One real bug found and fixed (FastAPI Depends resolution silently breaks for closures when postponed annotations are enabled -- moved dependencies to module level). Verified twice end to end: in-process TestClient and a real spawned server process hit with curl.

Fixed three real, pre-existing bugs that had kept every CI run red since P0: numpy==2.5.3 has no Python 3.11 wheel (repinned 2.4.6), extract_metrics crashed on an outline-less system font on ubuntu-latest, and a CLI test asserted against Rich-wrapped --help text that splits mid-flag on CI terminal widths.
Real-statement test: fixed Form XObject editing + text-state correlation through Do; bundled Roboto (OFL); ran the user's 10-step CLI/API test on a scratch copy, all passing, original unchanged.

web/ frontend scaffold (Vite+TS+pdf.js) plus UI-01 (page canvas + thumbnail rail) and UI-06 (password prompt), with real Playwright end-to-end evidence and CI wiring. Four real bugs found and fixed: missing CORS policy, a pdfjs-dist CVE avoided plus the getOrInsertComputed browser-compat gap it exposed, a real button/keyboard listener race in viewer.ts, and a password-retry message logic bug.

PageSpansOp/PreviewTextOp/ReplaceSpanTextOp backend, then UI-02 click-to-edit overlay and UI-03 inspector panel frontend, with 9 new Playwright tests (20 total in tests/web/). Caught a design gap before shipping (ReplaceTextOp would edit every occurrence of matched text, not just the clicked span) and two real bugs via automated browser testing: an inspector layout bug (text set inside a prepended icon element instead of a sibling text node) and a genuine JS reentrancy bug (contentEditable=false synchronously firing blur, re-entering cancelEdit before the outer call finished).

History panel with undo/redo (web/src/history.ts), backed entirely by COR-11's already-tested GET/POST .../history, .../undo, .../redo -- no new backend routes needed, just one extra server test proving replace_span_text's fields round-trip through history correctly. viewer.ts's reloadAfterCommit generalized into reloadDocument, now shared by both overlay commits and history undo/redo so there's exactly one place that refreshes everything after any document change. 5 new tests (369 total).

Before/after split view (web/src/compare.ts) with synchronized scrolling and a client-side diff overlay. One small backend addition: UndoRedoJournal.original_bytes (captured at construction, independent of the undo stack's max_history cap) plus a GET .../render/original route reusing the existing RenderPageOp against a throwaway Document -- no new Op type. Diff overlay computed in-browser (canvas pixel comparison) rather than reusing engine/verify.py's numpy harness, which is Python-only. One real bug found and fixed: a test asserting to_bytes() byte-identity failed because PyMuPDF regenerates a random /ID component on every tobytes() call even with nothing else changed; fixed by comparing text content instead. 8 new tests (377 total).

Keyboard shortcuts (Home/End, +/-, Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Shift+Z, c-to-compare) plus title/aria-label discoverability on toolbar buttons. Found and fixed a real pre-existing bug: isTypingTarget only checked INPUT/TEXTAREA tags, not contentEditable, so arrow keys while editing a span also navigated pages and broke caret movement. Found and fixed a second bug in the test suite itself (not the app): _commit_edit only waited for editing to visibly end, not for the post-commit reload to finish, which raced a UI-05 test on Windows CI only -- fixed at the source by waiting for a history entry to appear. Also caught a lint-job gap: ruff format --check hadn't been run locally since UI-04, and two UI-05 files were unformatted; now part of every gate run. 5 new tests (382 total).

Light/dark theme toggle (web/src/theme.ts) layered on top of style.css's existing passive prefers-color-scheme support -- a data-theme attribute on <html>, persisted in localStorage, cycling Auto/Light/Dark. Lives outside app.ts's screen-swapping via a new #pw-theme-toggle sibling to #app. One real bug found by the Playwright suite itself: a first fixed-position design overlapped and ate clicks on the viewer toolbar's Compare button at the test browser's window width, breaking four previously-passing UI-05 tests; fixed by making it a real in-flow reserved strip (body as flex column) instead of a floating overlay. 4 new tests (386 total). Closes out P3's UI-0x category: 8/8 done.

Merged the unmerged UI branch with main; built EDT-07/10/05/08/09/11 (engine + Ops + CLI + UI + Playwright evidence); fixed a mirrored click-to-edit overlay, journal rollback on failing Ops, a missing engine.fonts package entry, and spylls' stray top-level tests package; closed the three real-document follow-ups. CI unavailable (Actions jobs not starting).
